question_cn: 三兵对双兵，多出一个兵的战略价值是：
question_en: Three pawns vs. two pawns — the strategic value of the extra pawn is:

options.text_cn: 创造通路兵，或通过突破制造通路兵
options.text_en: Create a passed pawn directly or via breakthrough

options.text_cn: 多的兵用来换掉对方的兵
options.text_en: Use the extra pawn to trade off enemy pawns

options.text_cn: 三个兵保持在一条线上同步推进
options.text_en: Keep all three pawns on the same rank advancing together

options.text_cn: 多的兵保护王，不用于进攻
options.text_en: Extra pawn protects king, not used for attack

explanation_cn: 三兵对双兵的元思维：优势不在于兵的数量本身，而在于多出的兵能创造通路兵——要么直接形成，要么通过牺牲突破形成。通路兵才是最终制胜的武器。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: the extra pawn's value is in creating a passed pawn — either directly or via sacrifice breakthrough. The passed pawn is the ultimate winning weapon.
